claims.summary: For every odd p, m >= 2 and Q=p^e > 2^m-3, the full paired source at polynomial bound c >= 0 is generically Hasse-normal if Q divides c+1. Hence for every n >= 5 and d >= n-2 the original root-curve series is generically normal if Q > 2^floor((n-1)/2)-3 and 2d is congruent to n-3 modulo Q, without adjacent lower-dimensional normality hypotheses.
claims.assessment: Working proof by the integer unit minor at -1, Frobenius congruence, repeated full saturated paired descent and the stronger even paired transfer. Gives infinite explicit families in all dimensions and odd characteristics, not all degrees or pre-stable thresholds.
claims.rationale: The preserved congruence gives an unconditional all-dimensional progression beyond the prior conditional branch lift. Its mathematical scope is established, but no external novelty audit has been performed.
claims.next_action: Compare this source-preserving progression with the root-curve and positive-characteristic interpolation literature before claiming novelty or proposing publication.
